title: Physical interaction between MSL2 and CLAMP assures direct co-operativity and prevents competition at composite binding sites
authors: Nikolas Eggers; Fotios Gkountromichos; Silke Krause; Aline Campos-Sparr; Peter B. Becker
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇MSL2与CLAMP蛋白在复合结合位点上的物理互作与协同结合机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但主要依赖生化实验和染色质重构，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系，深度有限。
abstract: MSL2, the DNA-binding subunit of the Drosophila dosage compensation complex, cooperates with the ubiquitous protein CLAMP to bind MSL recognition elements (MREs) on the X chromosome. We explore the nature of the cooperative binding to these GA-rich, composite se-quence elements in reconstituted naïve embryonic chromatin. We found that the cooperativity requires physical interaction between both proteins. Remarkably, disruption of this interaction does not lead to indirect, nucleosome-mediated cooperativity as expected, but to competition. The protein interaction apparently not only increases the affinity for composite binding sites, but also locks both proteins in a defined dimeric state that prevents competition. High Affinity Sites of MSL2 on the X chromosome contain variable numbers of MREs. We find that the cooperation between MSL2/CLAMP is not influenced by MRE clustering or arrangement, but happens largely at the level of individual MREs. The sites where MSL2/CLAMP bind strongly in vitro locate to all chromosomes and show little overlap to an expanded set of X-chromosomal MSL2 in vivo binding sites generated by CUT&RUN. Apparently, the intrinsic MSL2/CLAMP cooperativity is limited to a small selection of potential sites in vivo . This restriction must be due to components missing in our reconstitution, such as roX2 lncRNA.
abstract_zh: MSL2是果蝇剂量补偿复合物的DNA结合亚基，与普遍存在的蛋白CLAMP协同作用，结合X染色体上的MSL识别元件（MREs）。我们在重构的初始胚胎染色质中探讨了这些富含GA的复合序列元件上协同结合的性质。我们发现，协同性需要两种蛋白之间的物理相互作用。值得注意的是，这种相互作用的破坏并未如预期那样导致间接的、核小体介导的协同性，而是导致竞争。蛋白相互作用显然不仅增加了对复合结合位点的亲和力，还将两种蛋白锁定在一种确定的二聚体状态，从而防止竞争。X染色体上的MSL2高亲和位点包含可变数量的MREs。我们发现，MSL2/CLAMP之间的协同作用不受MRE聚类或排列的影响，而主要发生在单个MRE水平上。体外强结合的MSL2/CLAMP位点分布于所有染色体，并与通过CUT&RUN生成的扩展X染色体MSL2体内结合位点集合仅有少量重叠。显然，内在的MSL2/CLAMP协同性在体内仅限于少数潜在位点。这种限制必然归因于我们重构中缺失的组分，如roX2 lncRNA。
